description: FD - Oblasti s potenciálně významným povodňovým rizikem (APSFR) is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Geoportal of the Czech Republic, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dibavod.cz. Areas of Potential Significant Flood Risk (APSFR) for which flood hazard and risk maps and flood risk management plans will be further developed have been identified from the perspective of fluvial flood risk. Coverage: CZ. The portal shows the English title as "FD - Areas of Potential significant Flood Risk (APSFR)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 4 download or service links in SHP, WFS, WMS, ATOM. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-cr.
